integrity_notes: Complete self-contained generator and Poisson-equation proof with a standalone symbolic checker; no external validation or claims concerning the full current large-deviation function.
scientific_limitations: Finite four-spin periodic Ising ring only; positive-rate alternating Glauber generator; signed heat at even-site flips in units of 4J; first two long-time cumulants only. Strict zero-temperature boundaries and larger rings are not covered.
title: Exact heat-noise identity in the four-site two-temperature Glauber ring
